cabinCategories.description: Star Princess interior stateroom — Princess's newest ship features fresh design and the latest MedallionClass technology throughout.
Bright ocean view stateroom on Princess's newest vessel. Large picture window and premium amenities.
Private balcony stateroom on Star Princess — the newest and most modern in the Princess fleet. Glacier Bay views are extraordinary.
Sky Suite with floor-to-ceiling windows, private balcony, butler service, and exclusive access to the Reserve Collection restaurant and amenities.

inclusions: All meals in main dining and World Fresh Marketplace

portsOfCall.description: Embarkation at Pier 91 (Smith Cove Terminal). Star Princess — Princess's newest ship — sets sail on a stunning 7-night Glacier Bay Alaska voyage.
portsOfCall.name: Seattle, WA

portsOfCall.description: Alaska's beautiful capital. With extra time in port, explore both Mendenhall Glacier and the whale watching grounds of Auke Bay. Don't miss local king crab at Tracy's.
portsOfCall.name: Juneau, AK

portsOfCall.description: A full day of scenic cruising through the crown jewel of Alaska's wilderness. Watch tidewater glaciers calve while National Park Rangers narrate the natural history.
portsOfCall.name: Glacier Bay National Park

portsOfCall.description: The legendary Gold Rush town at the head of the Lynn Canal. Ride the historic White Pass & Yukon Route Railway for stunning mountain and tundra views.
portsOfCall.name: Skagway, AK

portsOfCall.description: World's largest collection of standing totem poles plus the colorful Creek Street waterfront and fresh Dungeness crab — a quintessential Alaska stop.
portsOfCall.name: Ketchikan, AK

portsOfCall.description: Arrive in style in British Columbia's garden city. The Inner Harbour at dusk is one of the most beautiful sights in the Pacific Northwest.
portsOfCall.name: Victoria, BC

reviewSnippet: "Star Princess is stunning — you can feel how new everything is. Glacier Bay from the top deck was the most beautiful thing I've ever seen at sea. Princess's Alaska program is simply the best." — Verified Guest
